model_annotation: The figure presents two separate line plots comparing the training rewards over steps for two different models, Llama-On-Policy and Llama-LUFFY, on an "Easy Training Set" and a "Hard Training Set". In both plots, the x-axis represents "Steps" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 500, and the y-axis represents "Training Rewards" with a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.4 in the top plot and 0.0 to 0.2 in the bottom plot. In the top plot, labeled "Easy Training Set", the teal line ("Llama-On-Policy-Easy") starts near 0.0 and rises to approximately 0.35 by step 500, while the red line ("Llama-LUFFY-Easy") starts near 0.0 and rises to approximately 0.4 by step 500, remaining consistently above the teal line. In the bottom plot, labeled "Hard Training Set", the teal line ("Llama-On-Policy-Hard") starts near 0.0 and quickly declines to near 0.0 by step 100, remaining near zero thereafter, while the red line ("Llama-LUFFY-Hard") starts near 0.0 and rises to approximately 0.2 by step 500. Both plots feature shaded regions around each line indicating variability or confidence intervals.
